item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
… The closest I ever had to something like that was an ongoing dream I had one time. Yeah, ongoing, not repeating, and it popped up once every two or three nights for a couple weeks.

I won't bore with all the details… Let's just leave it with my old phrase, "this train of thought brought to you by Amtrak," and at one point I was apparently Hellboy.

It was the last night that got to me. I'm either watching a movie or playing a video game or… Something. Well this has happened a few times, that I go from "watching a screen", to "the screen is all of my vision," to "this is actually me." I'm at some sort of crime scene investigation, and while a couple of other people are interviewing someone, I see this manilla folder on the table with stuff spread out on the table. Looking over it I realize that I'm looking at a sequence of pictures, starting with the last one, but the pictures are going in reverse so I'm seeing it in the correct time frame.

I hear off on the side, "Well, you're just lucky you stopped half way through, the REALLY weird shit happens at the end." Did I mention I started at the end? So I get about 3/4 of the way through the pictures, and one is just written in red scratchy writing, "LOOK OUT!! ON THE CEILING!!! IT'S ABOVE YOU!!!" That's when I realize I'm starting to float up off the ground, and the ceiling fan is starting to spin faster and faster. I try to turn my head to look but I'm half frozen in fear, and I just get this impression that there's a dark horrible something up there dragging me up to my bloody chopped death…

And I wake up making the freakiest I'm-scared-out-of-my-mind noise I've ever heard. I also looked at the ceiling around six hundred and twelve times that night before passing out again an hour later.

….. I think I know what my next SCP might be..

item.title: Oh
item.content:encoded:
I have that same dream, except in mine, I'm in an alley, wearing a top hat and a cloak, watching the reflection of the streetlight flickering in puddles at my feet. I'm at the edge of the pool of light because the interface between light and dark is pretty.

Then this guy appears and starts walking towards me. I can tell he's utterly terrified for some reason, and that he feels nauseated and queasy and sick, and I suddenly realize he's on the verge of having a seizure, and I start thinking of what I should to do help, and I call out to him -

"hey, are you okay?" -

but I can tell his brain isn't processing speech properly, and as he approaches the circle of illumination, I look up at him, with the brim of my hat dripping rain in my face -

and then he just collapses on the cobblestones, and I realize that his seizure has begun - he's not thrashing, but he's not in himself any more, he's just a husk until his brain reboots

and I want to drop to my knees and start doing first aid, check his pulse, put something soft under his head, make sure he doesn't suffocate on anything, make sure his hands are empty because seizing people can squeeze so hard they break their own bones…

but I can't, my knees aren't working, all I can do is stare down at this man laying there on the rainy cobblestones, taunting me with my inability to help

and then I realize that further along the alley, there's someone watching me and this poor guy, and it's his girlfriend, and she's horrified

and then they both vanish

sometimes she vanishes first, sometimes he vanishes first, very rarely they vanish at the same time, but they both vanish

and I'm alone in the rainy alley again, watching the play of light on the puddles.

item.content:encoded: Of all my nightmares and night terrors, I have never had one resembling this yet, strangely enough. I've always seen the idea of shared dreams to be highly implausible, despite the fact that I had a shared dream in which I murdered and cannibalized a girl; she had the same dream. I suggest telling yourself that you both had the same reaction to the same source, as you grip your pillow with one eye open.
